outcome: Incidence of Epidural Morphine Induced Pruritus (EMIP)
cohort: 247 Chinese Han and Tibetan parturients after Cesarean Section
finding: The incidence of EMIP was 18.6% and was significantly correlated with a history of allergy and not using a serotonin receptor antagonist.
mod_finding: The study examined epidural morphine-induced pruritus after cesarean section but did not specifically compare different modes of delivery.
